title: cyclosorus gamblei
intro: Cyclosorus gamblei, commonly known as the Gymnocarpium fortunei or the Fortune's Oak Fern, is a type of fern that belongs to the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Cyclosorus gamblei include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate respiratory issues, and act as a diuretic. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
